summary: Claude Code, the coding agent that works on this repository, keeps per-session state in a .claude/ directory at the repository root. When an agent starts an isolated task, Claude Code creates a Git worktree, a second working copy of the repository, under .claude/worktrees/. Git sees that directory as new, untracked content, so git status lists .claude/ in every checkout an agent has touched.

This pull request adds one line, /.claude/*, to .gitignore, so that Git ignores everything inside the .claude directory at the repository root. Nothing under .claude/ is tracked on main, so the line hides no committed file. The repository's shared agent instructions live in AGENTS.md at the root, outside the ignored directory.

The pattern names the directory's contents rather than the directory itself, so that the repository can later share one Claude Code setting, such as .claude/settings.json, by adding a !/.claude/settings.json line. The first head used /.claude/, which would have blocked that line. The review flagged it, and the second commit changed the pattern.

groups.title: Git ignores the contents of .claude
groups.kicker: One new ignore pattern for Claude Code's per-session state
intro: .gitignore lists the paths Git leaves out of git status and git add. It held one pattern, /target, for Cargo's build output. The new pattern /.claude/* matches every entry inside the .claude directory at the repository root, because of the leading slash, including the worktrees directory and files whose names start with a dot.

A pattern that names a directory itself, such as /.claude/, makes Git skip the directory without reading it, so a later ! line, which re-includes a path, cannot bring back a file inside it. Naming the contents instead keeps Git reading the directory, so such a line works.

checks.text: Nothing under .claude/ is tracked on main: git ls-files .claude prints nothing, so the pattern hides no committed file.

The description's Testing steps hold at this head, run in a scratch copy: git status --short prints nothing with .claude/probe and .claude/worktrees/ present, and with !/.claude/settings.json appended, git status lists ?? .claude/settings.json and git check-ignore -v names line 3's negation.
